partition_policy.training: all target facts except source-exclusive validation and blind facts

results.name: GOF voltage-gated channel activity suppression
results.hypothesis: Direct activity suppression is especially coherent when the GOF driver enables a voltage-gated ion-channel activity.
results.body: R298 plus driver enables a descendant of GO voltage-gated ion channel activity
results.mechanism_rationale: The rule matches channel-blocking pharmacology to explicit GOF channelopathies using an ontology-native molecular-function constraint.
results.trapi_notes: The binding, activity-effect, molecular-function, and variant-qualified disease paths are TRAPI-expressible; ontology closure and disease constraints require post-processing.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(driver:Gene)
MATCH (subject)-[effect:AFFECTS]->(driver)
MATCH (driver)-[:ENABLES]->(:MolecularActivity)
      -[:SUBCLASS_OF*0..5]->
      (:MolecularActivity {id: 'GO:0005244'})
MATCH (driver)-[association:ASSOCIATED_WITH]->(object:Disease)
WHERE effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity'
  AND effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND 'infores:gene2phenotype' IN
      coalesce(association.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  AND association.subject_form_or_variant_qualifier = 'gain_of_function_variant_form'
  AND coalesce(object._miner_disease_descendant_degree, 0) <= 500
  AND object._miner_disease_superclass_degree >= 1
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id

results.name: GOF voltage-gated channel activity increase control
results.hypothesis: Increasing a GOF voltage-gated channel is the matched worsening control for R302.
results.body: R302 with increased rather than decreased channel activity
results.mechanism_rationale: The drug effect reinforces rather than suppresses the GOF channel mechanism.
